schemaPurpose: 사이트 구현값과 화면 관찰을 바탕으로 정리한 디자인 시스템 추출 데이터입니다.

meta.name: TOUN28 Solutions — Precision Skin Analysis
meta.productType: mobile-first self-guided skin analysis web experience

evidence.primary: Rendered page review and same-page CSS/DOM inspection

valueSourceLegend.implemented: Source CSS or DOM explicitly specifies the value.
valueSourceLegend.observed: Measured or visually inferred from the rendered page; use as a working reference.
valueSourceLegend.normalized: A semantic alias created from implementation values for design-system reuse.

evidence.captureLimit: The final quiz submission was intentionally not executed, so the detailed result content is represented by CSS and DOM template inspection rather than a live generated report.

designIntent.visualStrategy: A near-black mobile canvas, monochrome photography, fine technical lines, and compact high-tracking labels frame the experience as a controlled skin-analysis system rather than a conventional commerce quiz.
designIntent.contrastStrategy: High text contrast is reserved for headings, selected states, primary actions, and key product data. Secondary labels recede in gray and all structural separation relies on low-contrast rules.

--bk.note: The variable name is counterintuitive; it resolves to the primary light ink in the active dark theme.

--wh.note: The variable name is counterintuitive; it resolves to the primary dark surface in the active dark theme.

canvas.usage: Desktop surround and camera screen base.

surfaceBase.usage: App shell, standard screen surface, product-grid cells.

surfaceSubtle.usage: Disclosure panel, explanatory box, pressed state.

borderSubtle.usage: Primary dividers, progress rail, low-emphasis outlined action.

textPrimary.usage: Default heading, brand label, primary icon and structural line color.

textStrong.usage: Selected option copy, major CTA, full-light states.

textTertiary.usage: Meta labels, hints, helper text, inactive count.

textMuted.usage: Body copy in report information areas.

accentGentle.usage: Gentle-care dosage tier, status rule, dosage badge.

accentIntensive.usage: Intensive-care dosage tier, status rule, dosage badge.

scrimDefault.usage: Default background-image darkening basis; the vertical gradient increases it by 0.06 at the top and 0.14 at the bottom.

scrimQuestionAndMode.usage: Observed inline setting for questionnaire and mode-selection image backgrounds.

primary.value: Pretendard Variable, Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, Noto Sans KR, sans-serif

brandMicro.usage: TOUN28/TOUN28 Solutions labels and loading labels.

sectionMeta.usage: Question number, report labels, tags, badges and helper actions.

headingM.usage: Question title, result section title, modal title, loading title.

headingS.usage: Language name, skin type name, closing statement.

bodyM.usage: Option title, report body, product name and recommendation copy.

bodyS.usage: Descriptions, helper copy, modal description, privacy explanation.

buttonLabel.usage: Primary CTA, nudge CTA, modal CTA, restart action.

contentRules.brandAndSystemLabels: Use uppercase English system labels with unusually generous tracking; retain Korean display text in normal case and heavy weight.
contentRules.headingLineBreaks: Editorial headings may use intentional line breaks, especially on the mode screen and closing statement.
contentRules.numerals: Use leading-zero format for visible question labels (for example, Q.01) and compact numeric labels for options.

baseUnit.note: Most declared values align to a four-pixel rhythm, with some semantic exceptions.

pageHorizontal.usage: Language header/list, mode header/cards, question body/footer, report sections, modal.

compactHorizontal.usage: Question and result top bars; product information panel.

componentGaps.languageRow: 14px between flag and label stack; 16px toward trailing arrow

appShell.desktopBehavior: The app remains a centered narrow column; the surrounding desktop canvas stays near-black.

responsiveBehavior.breakpointModel: No explicit media-query breakpoint was observed in the inspected stylesheet; width is capped by the app shell.
responsiveBehavior.imageRule: Background images use cover/center; product imagery uses object-fit: cover.
responsiveBehavior.mobilePriority: All information architecture is optimized as a vertical one-column flow.

shadows.default: No card shadow; structure comes from rules and surface contrast.

shapeAndElevation.surfaceConstruction: The system avoids rounded cards in the core analysis and report flow. Square edges, horizontal dividers, and strong inversions create the visual hierarchy.

backgroundTreatment.mechanism: A screen-level pseudo-element uses a full-bleed image with cover sizing and a dark vertical gradient scrim above it; interactive/content layers sit above the scrim.
backgroundTreatment.scrimGradient: rgba(8,8,8, calc(scrim + 0.06)) at 0%; rgba(8,8,8,scrim) at 42%; rgba(8,8,8, calc(scrim + 0.14)) at 100%

photographicDirection.grading: Low-key monochrome or desaturated image, substantially obscured by a dark scrim.
photographicDirection.purpose: Adds human/skin context without competing with questionnaire readability.

technicalMotifs.grid: Thin 24px or 28px square grid in white at 0.04–0.05 alpha.
technicalMotifs.scanningLine: A 2px horizontal translucent white gradient for splash/loading; a 3px cyan scan line for camera analysis.
technicalMotifs.pulseRings: Three thin circular rings at 80px, 140px, and 200px on splash.

resultAssets.usage: Three-column product bundle grid in the result hero.

fastFeedback.usage: Option press, button opacity and disclosure open state.

signatureAnimations.splashPulse: Three rings expand from scale(0.85) to scale(1.15) while fading over 3s; each ring has a 0.6s offset.
signatureAnimations.scan: A horizontal line travels top-to-bottom-to-top in 2.4s on splash and 3s on loading.
signatureAnimations.loadingDots: Three 4–5px dots alternate opacity and scale on a 1.4s loop with 0.2s offsets.
signatureAnimations.loadPulse: Active step icon pulses scale/opacity on a 1.2s loop.
signatureAnimations.cameraScan: Cyan line animates during camera scanning over 1.5s.

motion.motionPrinciple: Animation is functional and diagnostic: it signals initialization, progress, scanning, and state change rather than decorative delight.

systemLabel.description: Compact uppercase brand or analytical category label.

optionList.layout: vertical stack; each item has 15px 0 padding, 13px internal gap, top and bottom 1px dividers

optionList.behavior: Observed quiz options advance to the following question on selection; the full-width CTA remains as a continuation affordance.

style.heightModel: 16px vertical padding in questionnaire; 10px–15px vertical padding in compact CTA/modal
style.radius: 0px in quiz/report; 13px only for camera actions

outlineBadge.description: Compact status, count, or dosage classification label.

resultSection.description: Repeated report module with eyebrow label, title, and content.

dosageCard.description: High-emphasis recommendation card in the result report.

skinSummaryRow.layout: flex row, gap 12px, 14px padding, 1.5px textStrong outline
skinSummaryRow.iconTile: 34px square; textStrong background and near-black icon

insightList.description: Minimal recommendation list with small circular marker.
insightList.layout: Each row: 11px vertical padding, 10px gap, 1px bottom divider
insightList.marker: 4px solid textStrong circular dot, aligned with body baseline

darkCallout.description: Informational block for bundle rationale or expanded explanation.

progressionNudge.description: Outlined upsell/progression box used to invite the more detailed analysis.
progressionNudge.layout: flex row; align-items center; justify-content space-between; gap 12px; 13px 14px padding; 1.5px outline

bottomSheetModal.formField: Full width, 1.5px textPrimary border, 13px 14px padding, 14px type, no radius

analysisLoader.description: Fullscreen state that translates data processing into a visible, clinical progress sequence.

cameraScanner.description: Optional face-analysis camera experience in the precision flow.

splash.composition: Centered brand stack over subtle grid, scanning line, and concentric pulse rings; loading statement anchors to 48px above the lower edge.

languageSelection.composition: 3px top progress indicator; 60px top-padded header; 4 full-width language rows; centered instructional note.

modeSelection.composition: Dark photo-led header and two large, horizontal choice rows; each choice expresses scope through a tag, title, short explanation, count badge, and arrow.

questionnaire.composition: Fixed 3px top progress bar; compact navigation top bar; padded question header; vertical answer list; separated bottom action zone.

resultReport.composition: Compact brand/status bar; product recommendation hero with a 4px dosage-status rule; three-column product grid; a sequence of report sections; closing statement, disclaimer, and restart action.

anatomy: three-column product grid with image overlay

interactionRules.touchFeedback: Global tap highlight is disabled. Most list-like controls use a rapid surface-darkening active state; primary camera controls use a 0.97 scale press response.
interactionRules.selection: A selected questionnaire option becomes a full-bleed white band within the content gutter and inverts ordinal/text to black.
interactionRules.progress: Question count at the top and the 3px fill at the viewport edge communicate step completion.
interactionRules.disclosure: Why-this-matters uses a chevron-like triangle that rotates 90 degrees on open and reveals a left-ruled helper panel.
interactionRules.modal: Modal enters from the bottom against an opaque dark backdrop; success, sending, error, and disabled states rely on copy/color change rather than layout shift.
interactionRules.camera: Scanner hides the action stack during active scanning and replaces it with processing steps.

positivePatterns: The core active dark theme provides strong foreground/background contrast for headings and primary actions.
Mobile controls use generous vertical padding, supporting touch interaction.
The camera screen exposes privacy copy and a denied-permission state.
implementationGapsToReview: No global visible keyboard focus treatment was observed outside the modal input focus state.
Several clickable selection rows are implemented as div elements; production reuse should use buttons or equivalent keyboard semantics.
Auto-advancing answer selection should preserve an explicit confirm/next option for users who need to review their choice.
Animated scanning/pulse effects should honor a reduced-motion preference in a production system.
Muted gray copy should be contrast-tested against #121212 at final font sizes.

do: Keep the shell narrow, centered, and mobile-first rather than expanding the content grid on desktop.
Use square components, fine lines, and measured whitespace as the primary hierarchy mechanism.
Pair Korean display content with concise tracked English system labels where the product voice calls for clinical precision.
Treat photography as a subdued contextual layer under a strong dark scrim.
Reserve semantic color for intensity and status; leave the base system monochrome.
avoid: Avoid bright gradients, rounded marketing cards, dense iconography, or decorative color that weakens the analytical tone.
Avoid soft shadows in standard report and questionnaire cards; use dividers and inverse states instead.
Avoid placing un-scrimmed imagery behind essential copy.
Avoid more than one dominant CTA per screen.

knownLimitations: This is an extraction from a single live deployment, not an official brand guideline supplied by TOUN28.
Exact background-image and product-asset licensing, source dimensions, and fallback behavior were not evaluated.
No explicit desktop breakpoint or prefers-reduced-motion rule was found in the inspected style block.
The application includes source naming inconsistencies for light/dark variables; the normalized aliases in this file are recommended for future reuse.
